sutta: 1.1 the pursuit ties low bar this was said by the Lord said by the arahan so I heard abandon one thing monks and I guarantee you non-returning what is that one thing greed is that one thing monks abandoned that and I will and I guarantee you non-returning non-returning to sansara beings coveting with greed go to rebirth in a bad born but having rightly understood greed those with inside abandoned it by abandoning it they never come back to this world again this two is the meaning of what was said by the Lord thus I heard
